description: A professional dermatologist-inspired skincare routine tailored for straight hair to maintain its health, manage frizz and promote overall hair strength.
frequency: Daily (morning) and nightly, with a deep conditioning treatment once a week
estimated_time: 15-20 minutes daily; 30 minutes weekly for the deep conditioning treatment

morning_steps.action: Apply a lightweight moisturizing shampoo focusing on hydration and detangling.
morning_steps.purpose: Gently cleanse the hair to remove any overnight buildup while hydrating the strands.

morning_steps.action: Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and apply a light leave-in conditioner or detangling spray.
morning_steps.purpose: Condition the hair to prevent frizz and maintain smoothness throughout the day.

night_steps.action: Wash the hair with a gentle cleansing conditioner, focusing on areas prone to dryness like the ends.
night_steps.purpose: Condition the hair overnight for maximum hydration and reduce morning frizz.

night_steps.action: Apply a leave-in treatment or hair mask to seal in moisture and nourish the hair.
night_steps.purpose: Provide deep hydration and protect the hair from environmental stressors during sleep.

weekly_steps.action: Perform a deep conditioning treatment using a mask or intensive conditioner.

do: Use sulfate-free products to avoid stripping the hair of its natural oils.
Choose heat protectants when styling with heat tools.
dont: Over-wash your hair as it can lead to dryness and frizz.
Skip moisture-rich treatments, especially in low-humidity environments.
common_mistakes: Using overly heavy products that can weigh down straight hair
Failing to manage heat styling which can cause breakage
best_products_categories: Hair masks and deep conditioning treatments

expected_results.2_weeks: Significantly reduced frizz, improved manageability of the hair.
expected_results.1_month: Enhanced hair elasticity and strength with visible shine and healthiness.
expected_results.3_months: Reduced split ends and a noticeable decrease in breakage.

expert_tips: Regular trims can help maintain the overall length and health of your hair by removing split ends.
Invest in a high-quality brush or comb to detangle your hair without causing damage.
